title: High-speed train crash in southern Spain leaves at least 21 dead
summary: Two trains derail near Adamuz, Cordóba province, leaving scores injured, state-owned broadcaster reports At least 21 people have been killed and several injured after two trains collided in southern Spain on Sunday night, authorities said. A train travelling from Málaga to Madrid derailed near Adamuz, crossing on to the other track where it hit an oncoming train, which also derailed, Spain’s Adif rail body posted on X.
